Method of Attack: Disguised as a one-time password (OTP) generator app for banking apps that steals user's banking credentials
Installs TeamViewer QuickSupport app to allow attackers to take over victim's phone
Uses Android accessibility services to secretly grant itself admin rights
Collects login credentials and sends them to C&C server
Starts TeamViewer session to allow remote control of victim's phone
Impacted Systems: Banking apps of customers in Austria, Hungary, Romania, and Switzerland
Attack Vector: Malicious Android app disguised as OTP generator
Acquiring admin rights on Android device
